metadata.overview: Reports F2Pool mining pool account data: hashrate, workers, balances and revenue. Read-only — pool state is polled over HTTPS, no device writes.

telemetry.name: hashrate
telemetry.description: Latest pool-side hashrate across configured accounts.

telemetry.name: workers_online
telemetry.description: Workers currently known to the pool.

telemetry.name: estimated_earnings
telemetry.description: Estimated income for the current day across accounts.

telemetry.name: transactions
telemetry.description: Earnings rows (F2Pool revenue transactions, changed_balance in BTC, mining_extra with the pps and tx_fee split) across configured accounts, fetched from the pool for the range in one call per account. start and end (ms) select the range; without them (a poll sweep) only the rows that arrived since the previous sweep, from UTC midnight on the first. aggrHourly=true returns one { ts, revenue } row per hour, the range total spread evenly.

troubleshooting: If alert.pool_unreachable, verify the apiUrl, apiSecret and outbound HTTPS connectivity.
If alert.hashrate_low, cross-check the fleet's own hashrate before escalating.

errors.ERR_ACCOUNTS_REQUIRED: Device opts.accounts must be a non-empty list of F2Pool mining user names.
errors.ERR_API_SECRET_REQUIRED: No API secret: set F2POOL_API_SECRET in the worker env (or opts.apiSecret).
errors.ERR_POOL_API: The F2Pool REST API call failed, timed out or returned a non-2xx status.
errors.ERR_RANGE_INVALID: start or end is not a finite number of ms, or start is after end.
